jobs.title: Software Development Engineer III | Backend

postalAddress.streetAddress: Urban Vault, 1193 and 1194, Rajiv Gandhi Nagar, 7th Sector, HSR Layout, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560102

jobs.descriptionHtml:
This is a senior IC role with significant architectural ownership and technical leadership expectations. A Seasoned SDE3 / Tech Lead at SpotDraft is expected to own and evolve critical systems end-to-end, influence technical direction across teams, and drive high-quality engineering decisions at a platform level. Beyond building systems, you will shape architecture, mentor engineers, and partner with leadership to guide long-term technical strategy. The role works closely with Engineering Leaders on system evolution and key technical decisions.

 

Requirements:

  • 7-10 years of backend development experience in product environments.

  • Strong Backend fundamentals (Python, Django/Flask experience is a plus).

  • Proven experience designing and evolving multiple distributed or high-scale systems in production.

  • Strong system design fundamentals with the ability to drive HLD + LLD independently.

  • Demonstrated experience owning systems across multiple iterations (build, scale optimize evolve).

  • Ability to reason deeply about performance, reliability, cost, and maintainability trade-offs.

  • Experience in influencing cross-team technical decisions and architecture.

  • Comfort working directly with stakeholders and driving alignment across functions.

    Responsibilities:

  • Designing and evolving scalable backend systems (HLD + LLD) with clear trade-off articulation.

  • Driving architecture decisions across services and influencing platform direction.

  • Building and evolving APIs that power core product and platform workflows.

  • Identifying opportunities for platform abstraction and reusable frameworks.

  • Owning services/modules end-to-end across their lifecycle, including long-term scalability and stability.

  • Proactively identifying and resolving performance bottlenecks and system limitations.

  • Leading and contributing to design reviews with a strong focus on long-term architecture.

  • Mentoring engineers and raising the quality bar for system design and code.

  • Driving technical debt reduction and platform simplification initiatives.

  • Partnering with Staff/Principal Engineers on complex system design and architectural direction.

  • Using AI tools pragmatically to improve engineering quality and velocity.

  • Ensuring systems are scalable, secure, reliable, and maintainable at scale.


    Why SpotDraft?

    • Brilliant teammates—Work with some of the sharpest minds in legal tech.

    • Expand your network—Interact with top founders, investors, and industry leaders.

    • Real impact—Take ownership of projects and see your work in action.

    • Big goals, bold moves—We trust you to deliver, innovate, and push boundaries.

     

    Our Core Values

    • Our business is to delight Customers

    • Be Transparent. Be Direct

    • Be Audacious

    • Outcomes over everything else

    • Elevate each other

    • Be Passionate. Take Ownership.

    • Be 1% better every day.

    All candidates’ personal data shared during the recruitment process will be handled with utmost confidentiality and used solely for hiring purposes, in line with applicable data protection regulations

    *SpotDraft is an equal-opportunity employer. Candidates will not be discriminated against based on race, ethnicity, color, religion, caste, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, veteran, or disability status

jobs.title: Account Executive- US
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About SpotDraft.
SpotDraft is on a mission to help legal and business teams move faster, together. Our AI-powered contracting platform is redefining how companies manage contracts, and our story deserves to be told in creative, human, and memorable ways.

We’re hiring high-impact Account Executives to drive revenue growth in the US market. This is a full-cycle sales role, you will own pipeline creation, run end-to-end sales cycles, and close deals across both enterprise and mid-market segments.

This role requires strong deal ownership, multi-threading across stakeholders, and the ability to translate product value into clear business and ROI outcomes.

Day to Day:

  • Own the full sales cycle: pipeline generation → discovery → demo → negotiation → close

  • Build and maintain 4x pipeline coverage for your target quota

  • Run compelling product demos independently, tailored to customer use cases

  • Drive multi-threaded deals across legal, procurement, finance, and business stakeholders

  • Partner closely with SDRs, Solutions Engineers, and Marketing on account and territory plans

  • Build strong ROI-driven business cases for customers

  • Work both:

  • Named accounts (50–100 accounts)

  • Broader SDR-supported pipeline

  • Represent SpotDraft at events and contribute to outbound pipeline generation

Experience needed

Must-Have Experience

  • Proven SaaS sales experience in a closing role

  • Strong track record of owning and closing full-cycle deals

  • Experience selling into multiple stakeholders (multi-threaded deals)

  • Ability to independently build and manage pipeline

  • Experience running product demos end-to-end

  • Strong business acumen — ability to build ROI/value narratives

  • Experience collaborating cross-functionally (SDRs, SEs, Marketing)

  • Comfort selling across enterprise and mid-market/SMB segments

Good-to-Have

  • Experience in legal tech or adjacent SaaS categories

  • Exposure to both named accounts and SDR-driven pipeline models

  • Experience building and executing territory/account plans

  • Experience working events for pipeline generation

  • Familiarity with US SaaS sales environment (quota, OTE, forecasting rigor)

Nice-to-Have

  • Experience selling to legal teams / in-house counsel

  • Background in companies like Ironclad, Sirion, DocuSign, or similar

  • Strong presence in New York or San Francisco markets

  • Experience managing a mixed portfolio (enterprise + mid-market/SMB)

Why SpotDraft?

  • Brilliant teammates—Work with some of the sharpest minds in legal tech.

  • Expand your network—Interact with top founders, investors, and industry leaders.

  • Real impact—Take ownership of projects and see your work in action.

  • Big goals, bold moves—We trust you to deliver, innovate, and push boundaries.

 

Our Core Values

  • Our business is to delight Customers

  • Be Transparent. Be Direct

  • Be Audacious

  • Outcomes over everything else

  • Elevate each other

  • Be Passionate. Take Ownership.

  • Be 1% better every day


All candidates’ personal data shared during the recruitment process will be handled with utmost confidentiality and used solely for hiring purposes, in line with applicable data protection regulations.

*SpotDraft is an equal-opportunity employer. Candidates will not be discriminated against based on race, ethnicity, color, religion, caste, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, veteran, or disability status

jobs.title: Senior Sales Development Representative - APAC

postalAddress.streetAddress: Urban Vault, 1193 and 1194, Rajiv Gandhi Nagar, 7th Sector, HSR Layout, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560102

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About SpotDraft

SpotDraft is an AI-native Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) platform built for high-growth companies. We make contracting fast, simple, and actually usable — legal teams using SpotDraft save 10+ hours a week and close deals 25% faster.

We're recognized by Gartner and Forrester, a Gold Sponsor at CLOC, and trusted by 500+ companies including Panasonic, Mixpanel, Airbnb, Abnormal and Chargebee.

We're a Series B company scaling fast, with real momentum behind us. This role is part of building that next chapter, not maintaining an existing one.

About the Opportunity
We're looking for a high-energy, Outbound-first Sales Development Representative to join our APAC team. This is a role designed for someone who wants to be the face of SpotDraft with prospects and at industry events.

You will be orchestrating complex outreach across social, phone, and in-person channels. If you have experience navigating the nuances of legal-tech or other complex enterprise business workflows and want a front-row seat to a scaling B2B SaaS rocket ship, this is it.

Requirements:

  • 3–4 years of SDR experience within a high-growth B2B SaaS environment. Preferably selling to Legal, GCs, Procurement or other Line of Business buyers.

  • Exceptional communication skills. You are as persuasive in a 30-second elevator pitch at an event as you are in a long-form strategic email.

  • Outbound mentality. You don't wait for leads to hit your inbox; you have a proven track record of generating your own opportunities.

  • Proven ability to multi-thread accounts, prioritize by ICP fit, and build outreach around genuine account research - not templated sequences.

  • AI literacy. You use modern tools (Claude, ChatGPT, etc.) to personalize outreach at scale and move faster than the competition.

What you’ll own:

  • All-bound Prospecting: Build and execute a multi-channel strategy (cold call, social, video, and email) to penetrate high-value accounts.

  • Pipeline Qualification: Conduct discovery calls with legal, operations, or other business leaders to understand their bottlenecks and align them with our AI-driven solutions.

  • Strategic Research: Identify key stakeholders within complex organizations and map out personalized "ways-in" for our Account Executives.

  • CRM Hygiene: Maintain a pristine record of all interactions in our CRM to ensure seamless hand-offs and data-driven GTM iterations.

Why SpotDraft?

  • Brilliant teammates—Work with some of the sharpest minds in legal tech.

  • Expand your network—Interact with top founders, investors, and industry leaders.

  • Real impact—Take ownership of projects and see your work in action.

  • Big goals, bold moves—We trust you to deliver, innovate, and push boundaries.

Our Core Values

  • Our business is to delight Customers

  • Be Transparent. Be Direct

  • Be Audacious

  • Outcomes over everything else

  • Elevate each other

  • Be Passionate. Take Ownership.

  • Be 1% better every day



All candidates’ personal data shared during the recruitment process will be handled with utmost confidentiality and used solely for hiring purposes, in line with applicable data protection regulations.

*SpotDraft is an equal-opportunity employer. Candidates will not be discriminated against based on race, ethnicity, color, religion, caste, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, veteran, or disability status
